We all think about our future and have dreams but it is not easy to see these dreams fructify

we do all kinds of work- farming, sculpting etc
some are farming and working at the bricks factory

Important wheat innovation for [sex of FGD] Now
• Seed driller
• Rotavator
• Harvester

Important wheat innovation for [sex of FGD] 10 years ago

More people are coming to our village to spread awareness about new development in agriculture
Earlier tractor use to be the only machine; few would own it and many would rent it for use
But now people are also willing to take risks especially the ones with large tracts of land
Education has also made a difference and people are more open to machines
Men do all the work while women do some selective work
Men are involved in all the activities from sowing to harvesting while women mostly do weeding and harvesting
Men drive tractors; women cannot
Women do a lot of work but there are some activities which are physically very demanding and only men can do those like field preparation
Women cannot do everything from scratch on their own; they will at some point need their husbands’ help
They can grow but they will not get fair price if they sell in the local market and they cannot on their own go to sell in the regional market since it is very far away
There is no transport facility in our village and the regional market is about 30 kilometers away; so while men can go it is more difficult for women to do so
Women have less exposure and information as compared to men
It will be easier for us since we can handle everything on our own
But we will need the guidance of our parents since they have more experience
We do not have money and so will need to borrow from our fathers
We may need help choosing seeds and fertilizers
We will use machines on rent
We can also take loan if we need money
Generally family has a joint land and even if they have more than one plot usually it is not in an individual member’s name
The head of the family, generally our fathers, takes all such decisions and if he is not alive then his eldest son takes on this responsibility
All adult members work on the plot as and when required
But whole family works during sowing and harvesting seasons
Unless they are using machines in which case not much labor is needed
Not applicable since men and women don’t have separate plots
But if they do then men will help on women’s plot since it is their family property
Women work on their husbands’ plots
All the household members work on the family plot
There is nothing like a man’s plot or a woman’s plot unless the women is a widow
A woman always consults her husband
She has to because who else can she consult; at best she will talk to other women farmers
She can also consult her sons if they are grown up enough
A man has more options since he has more exposure and knows more people
He can ask the block officers, the Panchayat
He can even call up the Kissan Cal center for their advice
He will allow her to join the group
Why should he object if she is already growing her own vegetables?
She is a pro and knows her work and so she will benefit if she joins a group doing similar work

Women mostly don’t consult or attend meetings where Block officers or people from bog organizations come and talk about new developments in agriculture and so if Ana joins such a group she will gain from collective wisdom
Women do a lot of work and know many things
He will let her sell since many women in our village grow vegetables
Yes, women selling vegetables is a common sight in our village
She will know how to sell and know the trading price
But women from rich family will not be allowed to do so
Women from not so well off families can easily sell; no one will object
Yes Adam will rarely ask her for help since she is also working hard to earn money
Besides she also tends to all the household work
On the contrary he will offer to help her in her work
Mary’s reputation in our village will not suffer since women need to work to support their families
In fact she will just be one of the many women doing this work
Yes, Mark’s reputation will suffer because it is beyond comprehension why he chooses to sit at home and not go out to work
Women are very capable of looking after their house and also work
So what is the need for Mark to sit at home?
People will goad him and push him to go out and work

His friends will snigger at him
Mark will be very happy; there is no reason for him to resent Mary successes since he did not have any objection to her working at all

“a man’s voice becomes louder and more confident if his wife is doing so well”
“wife’s prestige suddenly shoots up in the community and she can walk with her head held high”
Gender equality implies that boys and girls should both have a right to choose their partners
Parents should consult them both and marry them with their consent
Both should be allowed to study a lot and get equal opportunities at work
After marriage man and wife should walk side by side; wife should not be subservient to their husbands
Both should help create a better society
They will discuss and decide together

Love marriages are rare
